sources.summary: The country house is located on the shore of the Charvak Reservoir, an artificial lake surrounded by mountains, approximately 80 km from Tashkent. The village of Boladala is one of the more remote settlements along the reservoir, largely untouched by tourism. The house is located on the edge of the village, with open views of the lake and surrounding mountains.
